title: TradeZella Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison for Prop Firm Traders
excerpt: TradeZella raised its prices in 2026. Here is an honest look at TradeZella and its alternatives, including where each one wins and where Zentrade fits for prop firm evaluation traders.
seoTitle: TradeZella Alternatives 2026: Prices, Pros & Cons for Futures Traders
seoDescription: Compare TradeZella alternatives in 2026: Edgewonk, Tradervue, TraderSync and Zentrade. Current pricing, honest pros and cons, and which fits prop firm evaluation traders.
author: Zentrade Team

content.text: The best TradeZella alternative depends on what you trade and what you need: Zentrade is built for prop firm evaluation traders and starts free with paid plans from $9/month, Edgewonk is a single annual plan (about $197/year) for deep analytics, and Tradervue suits traders who want a long-standing, simple tool. TradeZella remains strong if you want broker auto-sync and a large feature set and accept a higher price.

TradeZella announced new pricing in July 2026: Essential at $35/month, Pro at $59/month and a new Ultra tier at $99/month, according to its own blog (annual billing lowers the monthly cost). That pushed many futures traders to look around. We make Zentrade, so we are biased; we will state our limits plainly and let you verify every number.
TradeZella: Where It Is Strong and Where It Is Not

items: Strengths: broker sync, a large feature set, strategy tools and a big user community.

Weaknesses for evaluation traders: higher entry price after the July 2026 change ($35/month for one broker account on Essential, per TradeZella's blog); analytics are generic rather than built around prop firm rules like consistency targets; and no free plan was listed in the sources we reviewed.
Best for: traders who value broker auto-sync above all and have budget for it.

Where Zentrade Fits, and Where It Does Not

items: Price: Free plan, Starter $9/mo, Professional $29/mo, ZenMode $59/mo (annual plans are cheaper).
Prop firm framing: profit factor, consistency score and equity curve on Professional, so you see the numbers firms care about.
Emotional journaling: a calendar with emotional notes and setup tags on Professional.

Discipline tools (ZenMode): the Live Discipline Copilot (a 15-minute pause after every loss you log, drawdown and daily-limit warnings), revenge trading detection, the ZenCoach AI coach and an automated weekly email report.
No automatic broker sync yet. Direct Tradovate and TopstepX import is in development (coming soon, no date). Today you import CSV files on Professional and above, or log manually.

content.text: How to Choose in Five Minutes

items: Do you need automatic broker sync today? If yes, TradeZella or Tradervue are safer picks.
Is your budget under $30/month? Zentrade or Edgewonk fit better.
Are you mainly fighting consistency, drawdown and revenge trading in evaluations? Pick the tool that surfaces those, which is what Zentrade is designed around.
Do you prefer one yearly payment over a monthly subscription? Look at Edgewonk (about $197/year).
Not sure? Start on a free plan and import one week of real trades before paying anyone.

faqItems.q: How much does TradeZella cost in 2026?
faqItems.a: Per TradeZella's own blog, Essential is $35/month, Pro is $59/month and Ultra is $99/month, with annual billing at roughly $26, $44 and $74 per month. Verify on tradezella.com as pricing can change.

faqItems.q: Is there a free TradeZella alternative?
faqItems.a: Zentrade has a free plan limited to 1 account. A spreadsheet is also free but requires manual formulas and upkeep.

faqItems.q: Does Zentrade have broker auto-sync like TradeZella?
faqItems.a: Not yet. Direct integrations for Tradovate and TopstepX are in development and listed as coming soon without a date. Professional and ZenMode support CSV import in the meantime.

faqItems.q: Which journal is best for passing a prop firm evaluation?
faqItems.a: No journal passes an evaluation for you. Pick the one you will actually use daily and that shows drawdown distance, consistency and behavioral patterns. For many evaluation traders, price and rule-focused metrics matter more than the longest feature list.

faqItems.q: Can I switch from TradeZella without losing my history?
faqItems.a: Export your trades from TradeZella as CSV if available on your plan and import them into Zentrade on Professional or above, reviewing the column mapping. Check that dates, symbols and P&L match before trusting your stats.
